input.question: When was the Cross of Liberty established?

documents.text: Coat of Arms Cross of Liberty for Military Leadership , Grade I Cross of Liberty for Personal Courage , Grade II Cross of Liberty for Civilian Service , Grade III The Cross of Liberty ( Estonian language : Vabadusrist ) was a medal established by then Prime Minister of Estonia , Konstantin Päts , on 24 February 1919 to honor people for their services during the Estonian War of Independence and conferred in three grades , each in three classes . Grade I was for military leadership , Grade II for personal courage , and Grade III for civilian service
